email.subject: Pinecrest Games has invited you to a coding assessment
email.body:
Hello,

Pinecrest Games has invited you to complete an online coding assessment for the Gameplay Programmer position.

Assessment: Gameplay Programming (C++)
Duration: 90 minutes once started
Deadline: Monday, 2 November 2026, 23:59

Start the assessment: https://codetest.example.com/a/pcg-7731

Make sure you have a stable internet connection before you begin. Good luck!

The CodeTest team, on behalf of Pinecrest Games
